tasks.notes:
# Task #60 — Delete the cairn migrate command

## Outcome

`cairn migrate` is gone from the CLI. `src/commands/migrate.ts` and
`test/commands/migrate.test.ts` are deleted; `src/index.ts` no longer imports
or registers it. Fully recoverable from git history if an old `.ralph/`
clone ever needs it again.

## Changes

1. **Deleted `src/commands/migrate.ts`** (~337 lines, carried the file's one
   `remove once all projects migrated` marker — removed along with the code).
2. **Deleted `test/commands/migrate.test.ts`** (~500 lines / ~27 tests).
3. **`src/index.ts`**:
   - Removed `import { runMigrate } from './commands/migrate'`.
   - Removed the `LEGACY` import (was only used by the migrate command's
     description string — `BRAND` alone is still used elsewhere in the file).
   - Removed the whole `--- Native migrate command ---` block (the
     `program.command('migrate')` registration, ~lines 184-197).

## Verification

- `grep -rn "runMigrate\|commands/migrate" src test` → no matches.
- `grep -n "LEGACY\|migrate" src/index.ts` → no matches.
- `bun build --target=bun src/index.ts --outfile /tmp/cairn-taskcheck` → builds
  clean (did **not** touch `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck` or run `./install.sh`,
  per task instructions).
- `bun test test/index.test.ts` → 30 pass, 0 fail. Checked beforehand: this
  file has **no** assertions on the `migrate` command name (only status,
  edit, logs, run, narrate, plan, init, summarize are checked), so no edits
  were needed there — the task description's "may assert" concern didn't
  materialize.
- `bun test` → **811 pass, 0 fail, 30 files** (down from 838/31 in the prior
  iteration — the drop is exactly the ~27 tests in the deleted
  `migrate.test.ts` file, as expected).
- `bun test test/legacy-markers.test.ts` → 5 pass, still green (the deleted
  file's marker is simply gone now, nothing left to flag).

## Notes for future tasks

- Left informational comments referencing `cairn migrate` untouched in
  `src/commands/init.ts` (lines ~12, ~328), `src/commands/run.ts` (a couple of
  comments), `src/brand.ts`, and `CLAUDE.md`'s dedicated migrate section —
  none of these are in this task's file scope, and none are functionally
  broken (they're prose describing behavior of a command that used to exist,
  not code that calls it). A future cleanup task could scrub these mentions
  if the machine-wide legacy-layout removal continues, but that's out of
  scope here.
- `test/config.test.ts:557` ("ignores a ralph.json left behind by an
  unmigrated project") is unrelated — it tests `loadConfig`'s legacy-file
  fallback, not the migrate command, and still passes.
- No discovered tasks this iteration — task matched the codebase exactly.

tasks.title: Delete test/legacy-markers.test.ts
tasks.description: Delete test/legacy-markers.test.ts. It exists to guarantee every legacy fallback carries the 'remove once all projects migrated' marker so this removal round could be mechanical; with every fallback now gone it has nothing left to enforce. BEFORE deleting, run `grep -rn "remove once all projects migrated" src/ lib/ install.sh` and confirm the only remaining hits are in src/brand.ts (the LEGACY object, handled by task 63). If any other file still carries a marker, STOP and report rather than deleting — that means an earlier task left work behind. This task is deliberately ordered BEFORE the src/brand.ts task, inverting what the planning notes originally said. The reason: deleting LEGACY forces a hardcoded '.ralph_' literal for the permanent .ralph_task_<id>_notes.md scratch exception, and this test fails on that unmarked mention — which would leave task 63 with a red suite and get it reverted to in-progress by the post-iteration validator. Tasks 51-61 only REMOVE marked mentions and can never introduce an unmarked one, so the guardrail has no remaining work. Do NOT modify cairn.json's healthCheck and do NOT run ./install.sh. Do not touch .cairn/tasks.completed.json, .cairn_iterations.log, .cairn_tasks_snapshot.json, .cairn/reviews/round-*.md, .ralph_task_*_notes.md, or audit/.

Fix the now-stale comments at run.ts ~364 and ~711. tasks.title: Decide the fate of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain — no production callers remain
tasks.description: Task #51 deleted warnIfLegacyApiKey and its two call sites (src/commands/narrate.ts, src/commands/run.ts), which were the only consumers of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain(). The function is still exported from src/config.ts and covered by test/config.test.ts, but nothing in src/ calls it — the resolution is now purely documentary, mirroring the same chain in lib/cairn_narrate_server.py (see task #59). Either (a) delete the helper, its AnthropicApiKeyResolution type, and its tests, leaving the Python server as the single implementation, or (b) keep it and give it a real caller — e.g. have runNarrate/runRun pass the resolved key into the narration server env instead of relying on the child process re-reading the environment. Do NOT normalize onto plain ANTHROPIC_API_KEY under either option: the loop deliberately blanks that name to force Max-plan usage. Sequence this after #59 so both sides of the mirror are decided together.
